model_ref: "a nice model coming this summer" (new family, "fat indeed, but sparse")
author: @arthurmensch (Mistral AI CEO)
text: First, we have a nice model coming this summer – we hope it will delight and surprise in a few capabilities. This will be the start of a new family of models, fat indeed, but sparse. We're opening up an early access program in July for key partners in research, government and the
notes: Tweet 2 of a 6-post thread (thread start https://x.com/arthurmensch/status/2066913353860018596). Fetched via X syndication; text truncated at the end as served. The model (Mistral Large 4, 1T sparse MoE) launched 2026-10-06, i.e. after summer.

author: @arthurmensch (Mistral AI CEO)
text: This model and upcoming ones will be open-weight.
notes: Same thread; open weights for Mistral Large 4 shipped 2026-10-29.

author: @arthurmensch (Mistral AI CEO)
notes: Reply to the viral "Le Chaton Fat" meme about a large Mistral model; ambiguous joke, followed next day by the thread above. Model was later nicknamed "Le Chonk" by Mistral. Low-confidence signal.

author: Mistral AI (official blog)
text: You can try the preview API today on Mistral Studio. Weights drop end of this month.
notes: Also: "We will release the weights by the end of the month". Fulfilled: weights released 2026-10-29.

author: Mistral AI (official blog)
text: A reasoning version is coming soon!
notes: No separately named Mistral Large 3 reasoning model appears in the docs model list or changelog through 2026-11-20; reasoning arrived instead via Mistral Small 4, Medium 3.5 and Large 4. release_id blank because it never shipped as announced.

author: DeepSeek (official API Change Log)
text: The official release of DeepSeek-V4-Pro will follow soon.
notes: Posted in the 2026-07-31 DeepSeek-V4-Flash Update entry. V4-Pro GA followed on 2026-08-13 (13 days later).

author: DeepSeek (official API News)
text: Starting at 04:00 UTC on Sept 14, 2026, all deepseek-v4-pro requests will route to V4.1-Flash at V4.1-Flash rates. This will continue until V4.1-Pro launches.
notes: First official mention of V4.1-Pro; no date given. The changelog was later amended to say V4-Pro API service continues after 2026-09-14. V4.1-Pro not released as of 2026-11-20.

model_ref: larger models in the V4.1 architecture family
author: @deepseek_ai (official)
text: Introducing the smallest model in our new architecture family, with native visual understanding. Designed for greater capability, faster inference, higher throughput, and scaling to larger models.
notes: Implies larger V4.1-family models to come; no names or dates. Same wording on https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news260910.
